info.description: Unified Scoracle API serving sport data pages, news, journalist tweets, health checks, and operational endpoints.
info.title: Scoracle Data API

get.description: Returns API name, version, status, and available optimizations.
Returns basic health status and timestamp.
Returns in-memory cache statistics (active keys, expired keys).
Verifies Postgres connectivity.
Returns configuration state for the Google News RSS source.
Returns news articles about a player or team from Google News RSS. Supports time-window escalation and strict name matching.
Returns per-sport cache state, since_id, last_fetched_at, and bearer-token configuration.
Returns sport data freshness and counts.
Positionless rating board (z-score engine). entity_type=player (default) or team. Composite + Specialist in one payload.

parameters.description: Board: composite (default), specialist, or a specialty label (e.g. Sacks)
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: Season year (defaults to the latest rated season)
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Filter to a position (player boards only)
parameters.name: position

get.description: Returns sport data freshness and counts for a specific league.
Returns metadata and search payload for a specific league.
League-scoped variant of GetTeamResults — leagueId comes from the URL path. Identical payload.
Returns the sport profile payload scoped to a specific league.
League-scoped trends payload. Mirrors GetTrendsPage with leagueId taken from the URL path.
Returns complete metadata and search payload for a sport.
Returns the team's list of finalized fixtures (status completed/seeded) for a season, framed from the team's perspective with opponent identity and W/L/D.
Returns cached tweets from the sport's curated X List. Refreshes on demand when older than the TTL; concurrent refreshes are coalesced via singleflight.
Returns cached tweets mentioning the given player or team. Matching uses the shared search_aliases logic.
Returns the entities with the highest recent vibe sentiment in the sport, using each entity's latest score from the last 48 hours.
Returns the most recent Gemma-generated sentiment score (1-100) for a player or team. 404 if no score has been generated yet.
Returns the N most recent vibe sentiment scores for an entity, newest first.
Returns the sport profile payload for an entity type and ID.
Season Composite/Specialist rating + per-event sparkline series for one entity.

parameters.description: Season year (defaults to the latest rated season)
parameters.name: season

get.description: Returns the entity's last-3 event averages and peer-cohort season averages so the frontend can derive recent direction relative to peers. Raw values only.
